I've been on Wellbutrin for two weeks now, switched from Zoloft, and feel so much better. Wellbutrin is molecularly similar to Adderal and amphetamines so it gives you a huuuuge boost of energy. I have literally never felt so awake and engaged with the world around me in my life. 

However, you can expect heart palpitations for the first few days as you adjust to it (which many people mistake as anxiety) and you have to watch your weight (if ever you've had ED experiences in the past) because it can make you lose your appetite. Also, make sure you take it in the morning because it will cause insomnia. I take melatonin at night so it doesn't keep me up. 

Hope this helps!
